entries.concept: Minimal Kubernetes Deployment and ClusterIP Service
entries.description: Minimal Kubernetes Deployment and Service manifests for a backend container. Deployment (apps/v1): 1 replica, selector app=backend, container image backend:latest on containerPort 8080. Service (v1): ClusterIP type, selector app=backend, port 8080 -> targetPort 8080.
decision_rules: Use as a baseline template for any backend service Kubernetes deployment
Service type ClusterIP — accessible only within the cluster; add Ingress for external access
tradeoffs: Single replica with no HPA — not suitable for production traffic without scaling configuration
No resource requests/limits — must be added to prevent resource starvation
No SecurityContext — extend with runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, capabilities drop ALL per CIS Kubernetes Benchmark
anti_patterns: Do not use image:latest in production — pin to a specific tag or image digest
Do not deploy without resource limits to shared cluster namespaces
